description: Returns the one command that deploys this project's app to the user's own Cloudflare account (run it in the app's folder: it links the deploy slot on first use), with the slot state and the latest deploys. Nothing is changed by this call. Scope: projects:read.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project used last in this session, or the only one.

name: deploy.run
title: Deploy command and recent deploys
